llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed OzBargain deal monitor that creates scheduled OpenClaw jobs and sends results to user-chosen destinations.

dimensions.detail: Scheduled outbound messaging and reading OpenClaw logs are proportionate to delivery troubleshooting, but users should ensure the configured chat destination is correct.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill requires the existing openclaw binary and includes a small manual-run wrapper; there is no remote payload loading, package install, or hidden setup behavior in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most controls are explicitly user-configurable, including job id, schedule, destination, topics, and language; the live troubleshooting probe should be treated as something to confirm before use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally creates persistent cron jobs and a narrow user-specific dedupe state file under .openclaw; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The ability to create/edit cron jobs, run catch-up checks, dedupe deals, and deliver messages fits the stated OzBargain monitoring purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm that you want OpenClaw to create recurring cron jobs, send deal summaries to the configured chat or group, and keep a local dedupe file of sent OzBargain links. For troubleshooting, confirm the destination before allowing any live probe message.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The delivery probe is part of troubleshooting a configured chat destination, but it should be performed only after confirming the target destination with the user.
[SQP-3] expected: The prompt template uses a language placeholder, and SKILL.md states language is user-defined, so this is configurable rather than a fixed locale constraint.
[SQP-2] expected: The dedupe state file is a narrow persistence mechanism required to avoid repeated deal notifications and its path and contents are disclosed.
